name: pi-hashline-edit-pro
description: Hash-anchored read/replace/insert/grep tools for pi-coding-agent. Every line gets a unique 5-character lowercase tokenizer-friendly anchor that stays stable across edits; stale or ambiguous anchors are rejected, never fuzzy-matched. Undo persists across r
